Wide selection and located in a large shopping center. Nice to have a look around if you're tired of the hilly city for a while.
I loved Claudia and Bruna, they are very friendly and provide excellent service.
Choosing products. But the woman at the checkout was very unpleasant, speaking English to me (why?) and mocking the customers.
A wide variety of pet products were offered, and the prices seemed reasonable, plus they had promotions.

I visited this store to buy a pet carrier for my dog that would be suitable for air travel.

Today I picked it up and, as you can see from the photos, it has never been used. As soon as I inspected it, I realized it was already damaged. Two metal bars are sticking out through the fabric, both at the front and the back, making the carrier completely unusable. On top of that, the zipper pull strap tore off on one side the very first time I opened it.

Because of this, I feel I was sold a defective product and completely misled. I would not recommend buying from this store.

Good evening, I am writing to express my dissatisfaction with this store and the girl who had tattoos, super long hair, and bangs! I'm giving 1 star because I can't give 0.
I entered the store and experienced a horrible lack of manners. She was on a phone call, saying all sorts of swear words and more. She didn't even say good morning or welcome me; she simply looked at me and turned her face away to continue on her phone without any respect, even though she knew I was inside listening to her unpleasant conversation. I also work in customer service and I've never seen anything like it. I just wanted some products, but since I'm not welcome and they don't treat me well, I left and will go to another store, not Tiendanimal, where I'm sure I'll receive much better service.

I absolutely love Tiendanimal! It’s the perfect place for everything your dog could need. The selection is amazing—you can find high-quality food, toys, accessories, and more all in one spot.

What really makes this store special is the staff. They are always helpful, knowledgeable, and genuinely friendly. You can tell they care about pets and take the time to give good advice.

Every visit is a great experience. Highly recommended for any dog owner!

The scale is smaller than I expected. I inquired about tax refunds, but the employees didn't know anything about it, which was disappointing.
I loved it! They had everything, and the woman who served us was the nicest, kindest, and most pampering with my pet. I recommend it 100%.
They have a huge variety and the guys who work at Bom Sucesso are very attentive; they even gave me a gift for the package I went to pick up.

The staff are super friendly and willing to help, however, I've noticed that for the third or fourth time in a row, I only see one girl (not always the same one) in the morning, with many customers waiting to pay at the empty checkout and delivery drivers waiting (I suppose they are Glovo orders) because the girl is ALONE serving customers in a huge store.
It makes me a little uncomfortable because I went there to buy something and couldn't because the wait was so long due to the number of customers for just one person, that I ended up giving up! No matter how hard and dedicated the employees are, no one can ever handle so much work alone in such a large store in the morning!
Apart from that, the service is excellent, it's just not better because the employees aren't machines yet!

Good experience

I am a regular customer of your store and have always been served with professionalism and courtesy. However, I am writing to express my dissatisfaction with the service I received today, February 13th, at 12:30 pm.

I was served by an employee I did not know, whose attitude was extremely arrogant. She showed a lack of interest in presenting options and clarifying doubts, being unhelpful and distant. This behavior contrasts sharply with the quality of service I was accustomed to in your store.

Despite the recent expansion of the space, the quality of service seems to have decreased. I hope this episode is an isolated case.

The new store is amazing!
Spacious and with a great variety of items.
Congratulations to the team at this store for their friendliness and helpfulness.
The store has some variety, but it's far too small. The aisles are so narrow that it's almost impossible to move through them.

This store has everything for pets, from toys to clothes.

And the prices were quite reasonable.

Friendly and attentive service at the Cidade do Porto shopping mall store!

Excellent selection of items :)

Whenever I go to Tiendanimal, I have the privilege of being served by Débora – the service is always excellent and she gives wonderful recommendations for my kitten! That's why I always come back :)))))

I placed an order in person at this store, they called me to say I could pick it up, and when I arrived they couldn't find the order and insisted it was impossible for me to have placed the order at that store. In other words, I'm the one who's wrong or forgotten. From their side, there was no mistake. Impossible.
